properties.description: A filter (notes on stdin, notes on stdout) that publish release runs before un-drafting. Everything outside the reflow2:container-image markers is kept verbatim, first; a re-run with the same digest is byte-identical and with a new one leaves one section naming it. Markers are matched with a trailing carriage return ignored; an unterminated section is refused rather than dropping the notes after it.
properties.name: docker/image-release-notes.sh — writes the image section, with the index digest, into a release's notes: appended, between markers, replaced on a re-run
